cited.title: Materials and Skin Sensitivity > Materials and Skin Sensitivity
cited.text:
## Our base metal
Every Parure piece starts with 316L stainless steel, often called surgical-grade steel. It's strong, doesn't rust, and contains over 60% recycled content.

## Gold pieces (SOLAR and MARINE)
Our gold pieces are coated using PVD (physical vapour deposition), which bonds a thin layer of gold-tone coating to the steel. PVD is much harder-wearing than traditional electroplating, so the colour lasts longer and is resistant to tarnishing.

## Silver-tone pieces (LUNAR)
LUNAR pieces are not plated. They're polished 316L stainless steel in its natural silver tone. Because there's no coating, the colour can't wear off. They are not sterling silver.

## Stones and pearls
- **SOLAR:** red agate, a natural stone.
- **MARINE:** freshwater pearls and blue enamel.
- **LUNAR:** star-cut cubic zirconia crystals.

## Sensitive skin
316L stainless steel is hypoallergenic and meets the EU Nickel Directive limits for jewellery, so most people with sensitive skin can wear our pieces without irritation. If you have a severe, diagnosed nickel allergy, please email hello@parurelondon.com before ordering and we'll talk you through it.

## Our 12-month warranty
Every piece comes with a 12-month warranty against manufacturing faults, such as a broken clasp, a stone coming loose or the plating flaking under normal wear.

## What isn't covered
- Normal wear and tear, including scratches and gradual softening of the finish
- Damage from accidents, bending or misuse
- Damage to pearls from water, perfume or chemicals
- Lost stones or pearls where the setting has been damaged

## How to make a claim
Email hello@parurelondon.com with your order number and a photo of the issue. If your claim is approved, we'll repair or replace the piece free of charge, including postage.

## Repairs outside warranty
We currently don't offer paid repairs outside the warranty period.

## Dispatch
Orders placed before 1pm on a working day are dispatched the same day. Orders placed after 1pm, at weekends or on bank holidays are dispatched the next working day.

## UK delivery
- **Standard (Royal Mail Tracked 48):** £3.95, 2 to 3 working days. Free on orders over £100.
- **Express (Royal Mail Tracked 24):** £6.95, next working day if dispatched that day.

## International delivery
- **Europe:** £9.95, 4 to 7 working days.
- **USA and Canada:** £14.95, 5 to 10 working days.
- **Rest of the world:** £19.95, 7 to 14 working days.

International orders may be charged import duties and taxes by the destination country. These are paid by the customer and are not included in our prices.

## Packaging
Every order arrives in our recyclable cardboard box with a cotton pouch. Gift wrapping is available at checkout (see Gifting).

## Tracking
You'll receive a tracking link by email as soon as your order is dispatched.

cited.title: Size Guide (2026) > Size Guide (2026)
cited.text:
## Rings
SOLAR and MARINE rings come in one size, the average UK size O.

LUNAR rings come in four sizes: UK J, L, N and P.

To find your size, measure the inside diameter of a ring that already fits you well and compare it with an online ring size chart.

## Bracelets and necklaces
Our bracelets and necklaces have adjustable clasps with multiple length options. To measure, wrap a soft tape measure or a piece of string where the piece would sit, then measure the length against a ruler.

## Bangles and cuffs
Bangles and cuffs are one size and rigid, so they can't be adjusted. Each product page lists the inner diameter: compare it with a bangle that already fits you. The MARINE wave cuff has an opening at the back so it slips on from the side, but please don't bend it.

## Product measurements
Where we have exact measurements, they are listed on the product page. If a measurement you need is not listed, email hello@parurelondon.com and we will help.
